usage: Policy that ensures all SCM push operations will trigger CI/CD job
name: Every code push should trigger a CI/CD job
description: Every code push should have an associated CI/CD job triggered.
detailedDescription: Pushed code that is not being analyzed by your CI/CD jobs may indicate that code is being delivered straight to production. This means that testing and security vulnerability analysis may not be occurring before deploying to production.

args.name: cicd
args.label: CI/CD
args.tooltip: Please check why all commits does not triger CI/CD job?
